overall_summary: Family emotional shorts (Maa, Papa, Bhai) and self-respect smartphone/digital cleanup stories performed significantly better in views and engagement compared to generic heartbreak topics. However, recent hyper-niche digital interface hooks faced diminishing returns due to fatigue.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos about Mother (OfHrAp3r1G8 - 214 views), Father (v8krtdmxbPs - 117 views), and Brother (m4cgM90y9JU - 88 views) vastly outperformed core heartbreak niches.
winning_patterns.action: Allocate a small content bucket to expand beyond romantic heartbreak into universal family emotional dynamics.

winning_patterns.evidence: JPf_3ebfnuk ('तुम थके हो… हारे नहीं') achieved solid views (42) and likes (5) with zero comments.
winning_patterns.action: Incorporate short, grounding self-motivation micro-narratives alongside romantic pain.

winning_patterns.evidence: rwOUYo_hayQ (41 views) and wFimeeP_aVc (34 views) performed well when tying self-respect to distinct digital actions like status lists or blue ticks.
winning_patterns.action: Continue focusing on tangible everyday digital behaviors for self-respect topics.

weak_patterns.evidence: Recent videos focusing on extreme micro-actions (e.g., changing wallpapers, removing profile pictures from series apps like cuKSS0gHyt0 and 6KVEZc22kS8) dropped to 0-1 views.
weak_patterns.action: Move away from hyper-niche UI setting changes and pivot toward broader relatable life moments.

weak_patterns.evidence: Abstract hooks about loneliness or late-night thoughts (e.g., uIbMpCjVutQ) stagnated in single-digit views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic late-night tropes without a specific, grounded anchor object or situation.
